# Agora

> Agora helps you discover events near you that match your taste, RSVP with friends, and capture memories from the night.

Agora is an invite-friendly events app: a personal compass that turns your music, sports, and culture interests into nearby plans, plus tools for organizers to run their venues and read demand in their city.

- [Log in](/login): Sign in to your account.
